title: Discovery and Characterization of Uracil Derivatives Targeting the Set-and-Ring Domain of UHRF1.
authors: Akrani, Ifigeneia; Driva, Danai; Tsakalidis, Efstratios; Mozumdar, Nandini; Mavridi, Danai; Panara, Anthi; Epiphaniou, Kalypso; Chalkiadaki, Maria; Wright, Andreanna Frances; Halabalaki, Maria; Tsoka, Angeliki; Zoidis, Grigoris; Vorgias, Constantinos; Sproul, Duncan; Gikas, Evangelos; Kriaucionis, Skirmantas; Mikros, Emmanuel; Myrianthopoulos, Vassilios
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子尿嘧啶衍生物靶向UHRF1的SRA结构域以抑制其与半甲基化DNA的识别，结合分子模拟与热力学实验，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The Set and Ring domain of the UHRF1 oncogene is responsible for its interaction with hemimethylated DNA and faithful propagation of epigenetic signaling over cellular replication. Inhibiting this recognition can have serious implications for UHRF1 functionality and may possibly enable therapeutic interventions. Based on a previous finding indicating a promising in vitro DNA demethylating potential of a pyrimidine derivative, a subscaffold search was performed in the NCI/DTP compound repository to discover similar molecules and evaluate their affinity for the SRA domain of UHRF1. Toward this direction, several compounds were evaluated using a thermal melt screen, and the most promising hits were subsequently studied by calorimetry in terms of their capacity to bind the 5-methylcytosine recognition site of UHRF1. A markedly different thermodynamic profile between the two confirmed hits with an intense enthalpy-entropy compensation signature was determined. The systems were further studied by biased and unbiased molecular simulations, computational hydration mapping, and calorimetry-based heat capacity measurements to devise a hypothesis on the structural requisites for efficient SRA binding. The most potent compound was evaluated for its DNA methylation effects against the UHRF1-dependent colorectal cancer HCT116 cells, where promising global demethylating activity reaching an approximate 75% reduction compared to control was achieved after treatment with 25 muM of NSC232005. Based on the presented results, rationally substituted analogues of the uracil scaffold appear as highly promising UHRF1 modulators for exploring its diverse functionalities and validating the protein as a drug target.
abstract_zh: UHRF1癌基因的SET和Ring结构域负责其与半甲基化DNA的相互作用以及表观遗传信号在细胞复制过程中的忠实传播。抑制这种识别可能对UHRF1功能产生严重影响，并可能为治疗干预提供机会。基于先前发现一种嘧啶衍生物具有前景的体外DNA去甲基化潜力，在NCI/DTP化合物库中进行了子骨架搜索，以发现相似分子并评估它们对UHRF1 SRA结构域的亲和力。为此，使用热熔解筛选评估了多种化合物，随后通过量热法研究了最有前景的候选物结合UHRF1 5-甲基胞嘧啶识别位点的能力。两个确认的候选物之间表现出显著不同的热力学特征，并伴有强烈的焓-熵补偿信号。通过有偏和无偏分子模拟、计算水合映射以及基于量热法的热容量测量进一步研究了这些系统，以提出高效SRA结合的结构要求假说。最有效的化合物在UHRF1依赖性结直肠癌HCT116细胞中评估了其DNA甲基化效应，在用25 μM NSC232005处理后，实现了有前景的全局去甲基化活性，与对照相比约减少75%。基于所呈现的结果，合理取代的尿嘧啶骨架类似物作为UHRF1调节剂显示出高度前景，可用于探索其多种功能并验证该蛋白作为药物靶点。
